title: The stickers, iii
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · the aggregator
logline: Wednesday. The vet's verdict by phone: 'They'll pass.' Wood walks the pup on the beach and does not look. The strip does not look either. Four panels of the sea.

panels.composition: The beach, November. WOOD walking. BARNABY II ahead. Wood looking at the sea, deliberately.
panels.caption: 'They'll pass,' the vet said.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, a man walking a November beach looking deliberately out at the sea while a small three-legged dog trots ahead
razor-sharp brush and ink, a gray November sea with small waves, nothing else, no words

panels.composition: The sea. The dog's ears at the bottom edge, busy with something off-panel. Wood's back.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, a gray sea with a man's back turned toward it and a small dog's ears just visible at the bottom edge, no words

panels.composition: The sea. The dog trotting back into frame, light, done. Wood not asking.
